releaseNotes: Multi-phase team competitions now keep all phases and show classification tables for each card.
changelog: Keeps A and B when Traquinas exposes both team cards.
Parses classification tables from team-competition cards instead of dropping them.
Recognizes phase labels like 1A FASE and 2A FASE GRUPO N from the card text.
Preserves all detected phases instead of collapsing them to the last one.
